status: completed; restricted exact gates and computational controls; FINAL-LINK1 remains open
headline: Linear source reads do not block the equality-frontier target; short delta handles, equality-only clause-first DAGs, generic amortization, product-only typed cycles, and trace-defined A-code acquisition each omit a necessary charge.
formal_results: Equality-frontier traffic: q=M^(1/3), L=M^(2/3) has qL=M; one source scan is allowed, one full scan per child costs M^(4/3).
Payload inheritance: for F=(x_1 OR ... OR x_w) AND P on disjoint variables, every clause-first residual is exactly P.
Honest delta cycle: an M^b handle that must expand to Theta(M) has reverse scale exponent at least 1/b, so the round-trip product is at least one.
Tagged address family: clause-first plus unit propagation plus exact residual equality yields exactly 2^h distinct satisfiable states at depth h and Theta(M)-scale terminal residuals.
QLEN equality: equal maximum-size children saturate sum s_i^k <= (sum s_i) S_max^(k-1).
Disjoint pointer-chain oracle: q branches of R edges require q(R+1) black-box queries.
Typed cycle: product below one suppresses the starting exponent but does not imply Williams endpoint entry.

Assuming a base polynomial SAT decider, no total computable extractor can return a valid runtime exponent for every polynomial-time SAT-decider code; proof uses padded deciders and the recursion theorem.
weakest_survivor: A streamed typed successor with exact shared semantic acquisition, honest expanded logical scales, charged aggregate decoder/source traffic, acquisition covariance, coherent physical-size cycles, and least root Bellman budgets C_0+S_0<2cos(pi/7).
scope_guard: No result is an unrestricted SAT lower bound. The pointer-chain result is oracle/model relative; the clause-first family is bypassable by semantic VALUE; padded-code results attack trace-defined acquisition, not all static compilers.
